answer: Make standing slow and public: a new identity must complete a sequence of distinct, time-spaced tasks under a named mentor, with every result kept in a crystal-clear ledger anyone can audit. Established peers then whisper-verify it through private pairwise checks on its past work, and only a consistent record earns the violet mark of standing. An attacker must shepherd each fake through the same slow sequence, pass separate continuity checks for each, and put a mentor's reputation at risk every time, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand times the time and reputation of one honest identity.
